     94 +## 1. Design Philosophy
     95 +
     96 +### OLD Design (oc-1 default)
     97 +- **Flat, utilitarian** — standard dark theme with sharp borders
     98 +- **Shadows for depth** — traditional CSS box-shadows (sm, md, lg)
     99 +- **No glassmorphism** — solid opaque backgrounds
    100 +- **No glow effects** — standard hover/focus states
    101 +- **Standard radius** — `var(--radius-md)` ~8px everywhere
    102 +- **No ambient atmosphere** — plain backgrounds
    103 +
    104 +### NEW Design (Aurora)
    105 +- **Digital luminescence** — elements emit light from within
    106 +- **Glass morphism everywhere** — `backdrop-filter: blur()` on surfaces, transparency layers
    107 +- **Glow system** — cyan/violet/rose/green/amber contextual glow on hover/focus/active
    108 +- **Mode-aware tokens** — dark mode emits light upward, light mode refracts it downward
    109 +- **Custom radius system** — 6px → 10px → 14px → 18px → 24px (larger, softer corners)
    110 +- **Grain texture** — subtle noise overlay on entire app for organic feel
    111 +- **Spring animations** — bounce/spring easing curves for dialogs, buttons
    112 +- **Color-coded identity** — cyan = user, violet = assistant, amber = permission, green = success, rose = error
    113 +

    115 +
    116 +## 2. Foundation Tokens

    122 +| `--ease-spring` | `cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1)` | Bouncy interactions |
    123 +| `--ease-snappy` | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | Dialog open/close |

    961 +---
    962 +
    963 +## 11. Animation System
    964 +
    965 +### Keyframes
    966 +
    967 +| Animation | Purpose | Behavior |
    968 +|-----------|---------|----------|
    969 +| `aurora-breathe` | Thinking indicator glow | Opacity 0.7↔1.0, shadow 8px↔18px, 2s ease-in-out infinite |
    970 +| `aurora-breathe-light` | Light mode variant | Same pattern, teal instead of cyan, softer glow |
    971 +| `aurora-pulse` | Generic element pulse | Shadow 8px↔20px, 2s cycle |
    972 +| `aurora-shimmer` | Background position | -200% → 200%, for gradient animations |
    973 +| `aurora-dialog-in` | Dialog open | scale(0.92) translateY(8px) → scale(1), 300ms snappy |
    974 +| `aurora-dialog-out` | Dialog close | scale(1) → scale(0.95) translateY(4px), 150ms ease-in |
    975 +| `thinkingPulse` | App-level thinking pulse | opacity 1↔0.5, shadow 8px↔2px, 1.5s |
    976 +
    977 +### Reduced Motion
    978 +
    979 +All animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`:
    980 +- All `animation-duration` forced to `0.01ms`
    981 +- All `transition-duration` forced to `0.01ms`
    982 +- `animation-iteration-count: 1` — no looping
    983 +

    1009 +- Thinking: pulsing glow dot

    1018 +
    1019 +## 13. Global Effects
    1020 +
    1021 +### Grain Texture Overlay
    1022 +
    1023 +**OLD:** No texture
    1024 +**NEW:** `body::before` pseudo-element:
    1025 +- `position: fixed; inset: 0` — covers entire viewport
    1026 +- `opacity: 0.02` — barely perceptible
    1027 +- SVG noise pattern: `feTurbulence fractalNoise baseFrequency=0.9 numOctaves=4`
    1028 +- `pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999` — non-interactive, top layer
    1029 +- Creates organic, film-like texture over the entire app
    1030 +
    1031 +### Selection Color
    1032 +
    1033 +**OLD:** Browser default
    1034 +**NEW:** `::selection { background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.22) }` — cyan-tinted text selection
    1035 +
    1036 +### Focus Visible
    1037 +
    1038 +**OLD:** Standard browser outline
    1039 +**NEW:** `2px solid var(--aurora-accent)` outline, `2px` offset — cyan focus rings
    1040 +
    1041 +### Cursor Mandate
    1042 +
    1043 +**OLD:** Some elements missing pointer cursor
    1044 +**NEW:** All buttons, links, triggers, summaries explicitly get `cursor: pointer`
    1045 +

    1047 +
    1048 +## Summary: Design Language Shift
    1049 +
    1050 +| Aspect | OLD (oc-1) | NEW (Aurora) |
    1051 +|--------|-----------|--------------|
    1052 +| **Philosophy** | Flat, utilitarian | Luminescent, atmospheric |
    1053 +| **Backgrounds** | Solid opaque | Glass morphism (blur + transparency) |
    1054 +| **Borders** | Theme tokens (gray) | Cyan-tinted rgba borders |
    1055 +| **Shadows** | CSS shadow tokens | Contextual glow halos |
    1056 +| **Radius** | 4-16px (token-based) | 6-24px (larger, softer) |
    1057 +| **Hover** | Background color change | Glow + float + border brighten |
    1058 +| **Focus** | Standard ring | Cyan glow with 3px ring |
    1059 +| **Active** | Scale down | Scale down + glow reset |
    1060 +| **Colors** | Neutral grays | Cyan/violet/amber/rose semantic |
    1061 +| **User identity** | None | Cyan border + "You" label |
    1062 +| **Assistant identity** | None | Violet border + "⬡ OPENCODE AI" |
    1063 +| **Thinking** | Plain text | Pulsing glow dot + card |
    1064 +| **Code blocks** | Solid bg + shadow | Glass bg + aurora border |
    1065 +| **Scrollbar** | Hidden | Visible, thin, cyan-tinted |
    1066 +| **Animations** | 150ms ease | Spring/snappy easing |
    1067 +| **Texture** | None | Film grain overlay |
    1068 +| **Selection** | Default | Cyan-tinted |
    1069 +| **Progress** | Solid fill | Aurora gradient + glow |
    1070 +| **Tags** | Square chips | Full pill shape |
    1071 +| **Menus/Dialogs** | Solid raised | Frosted glass + glow shadow |
    1072 +| **Logo** | Static | Glowing drop-shadow |
    1073 +| **Links** | Standard | Glow on hover |
    1074
